explanation: The area in the Middle East that the Israelites were to conquer and settle in, according to God's promise to Abraham.
A people descended from the patriarch Israel (Jacob), who make up the twelve tribes of the nation of Israel.
A leader chosen by God to rule over and protect the Israelites against their enemies, and to bring justice and order.
A city in Canaan that was conquered by the Israelites and later became the capital of the kingdoms of Israel and Judah.
One of the twelve tribes of Israel; also the name of the southern kingdom after the nation was divided.
Various peoples and nations who fought against the Israelites and threatened their existence and security.
A covenant or agreement between two or more parties, often formed to cooperate and strengthen one another.
To take control of an area or city by means of military force, as the Israelites did in Canaan.
Loyalty and trust in God and his promises, along with obedience to his commands and instructions.
